surface_mechanism_description: The TDMAT precursor reacts with SiO2 surface and forms a TiN monolayer with N(CH3)2 ligand by producing HN(CH3)2. Subsequent H2, H2/N2 mixture, and N2 plasmas terminate the surface through transposition reactions by producing the HN(CH3)2, N(CH3)2, and/or the hydrocarbon by-products.
evidence: The possible chemical reaction of TiN deposited using TDMAT with H2, H2/N2 mixture, and N2 plasmas can be explained by pointing out that the TDMAT precursor reacts with SiO2 surface and forms a TiN monolayer with N(CH3)2 ligand by producing HN(CH3)2. Subsequent H2, H2/N2 mixture, and N2 plasmas terminate the surface through transposition reactions by producing the HN(CH3)2, N(CH3)2, and/or the hydrocarbon by-products.
